name: Silky Sutures

angles.text: Hammerfall is a vital Horde stronghold in the Arathi Highlands. Doctor Victor's work keeps its defenders healthy and ready to protect the faction's position there.
As an undead, you bring the Forsaken's pragmatic, unsentimental medical knowledge to Hammerfall, using resources from the highlands to keep the clinic working.

faq.answer: Doctor Gregory Victor oversees Hammerfall's infirmary as its medical officer and trauma surgeon. He treats wounded guards and laborers with a blunt manner and mordant wit. Despite shortages and unrepaired siege damage, he keeps the ward working.

Doctor Victor needs spider silk because Hammerfall's infirmary is nearly out of ordinary supplies. He twists strong highland spider silk into sutures to close wounds when proper thread is unavailable.
faq.q: Why does Doctor Victor need spider silk?

faq.answer: Hammerfall shows clear signs of neglect and strain. Its siege damage remains unrepaired, and Doctor Victor sees that neglect as official policy. With little aid or supplies, the guards, laborers, and medical staff must make do.
faq.q: What condition is Hammerfall in during this quest?

faq.answer: The spiders roam the wilderness of the Arathi Highlands around Hammerfall. They must be hunted across the highland plains to gather silk for Doctor Victor's sutures, then brought back to the clinic.
faq.q: Where do the spiders for this quest come from?

faq.answer: Doctor Victor jokes that infection is the least of a wounded soldier's worries when he stitches them with spider silk. His dark humor reflects the demands of frontline care, where stopping blood loss and treating grave wounds come before sterile conditions.
faq.q: Why is Doctor Victor sarcastic about infection?

faq.answer: Hammerfall is isolated in a contested part of the Arathi Highlands and faces hostile threats. Reinforcements and supplies arrive infrequently, leaving the garrison and infirmary short of materials, tools, and healing supplies.
faq.q: Why are supplies so scarce at Hammerfall?

faq.answer: Doctor Gregory Victor's infirmary treats the laborers and guards stationed at Hammerfall. Keeping them healthy helps the outpost remain fortified and functional despite danger and structural damage.
faq.q: Who does the infirmary in Hammerfall treat?

sections.body: Hammerfall endures in the Arathi Highlands, though siege damage still mars its defenses. Doctor Gregory Victor, the outpost's physician, sees the neglect as official policy. With little support and crumbling fortifications around him, he keeps the infirmary running. Its care helps laborers and sentinel guards stay on their feet and ready for conflict.
sections.title: The Crumbling Outpost

sections.body: Medical supplies are running low at Hammerfall, so Doctor Victor seeks another way to stitch wounds. Tough highland spider silk can be twisted into resilient sutures when bandages and ordinary thread are scarce. Victor jokes that infection is the least of a wounded soldier's worries. The silk gives the infirmary thread to patch up defenders in hostile territory.
sections.title: Makeshift Medical Supplies

sections.body: Doctor Gregory Victor greets travelers with dry jokes about grave prognoses and stitches made from spider silk. His humor masks the hard truth of running a frontline clinic while Hammerfall remains isolated. Regular aid is rare in the highlands, and travelers can help keep the clinic supplied. Victor relies on improvised remedies and determination to care for the wounded as the outpost decays around him.
sections.title: Gallows Humor in Hammerfall

summary: At Hammerfall, Doctor Gregory Victor is turning to spider silk as infirmary supplies dwindle. Siege damage remains unrepaired, and the outpost's guards and laborers still need care.
